title: Tenjo Tenge
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Street brawlers Souichiro Nagi and Bob Makihara enter Toudou Academy planning to rule it, only to find a school built to teach combat, where some students have ki-based powers. They join the Juken Club against the ruling Executive Council and are drawn into a conflict left unresolved since Japan's feudal era. The Viz edition is uncut; the earlier CMX edition was heavily censored.
life_message: Strength matters only when you find a reason to be strong beyond strength itself.

folkways.japan: School-delinquent (yankii) fighting culture and martial-arts lineages from the feudal era are Japanese genre conventions.

delivery.evidence: Characters often contemplate the meaning of fighting and strength (Wikipedia); reviewer calls it pandering, not moralizing.
delivery.note: Reflections on strength are voiced by characters between fights rather than by narration (to verify).

winners_losers: The Juken Club fighters are favoured; the worldview that strength needs a purpose gets sympathy, though combat itself is celebrated.
